items.title: American Express (AXP) Stock Still Looks Cheap After A 120% Five Year Run
items.summary: American Express has delivered a 120.0% share price return over the past five years, while the latest intrinsic value estimate using the Excess Returns model still points to the stock trading below that intrinsic value. At the same time, traditional earnings multiples look roughly in line with the market.
